description:
Reentrancy in FixedRateVault._hedge(address,uint256) (src/vault/FixedRateVault.sol#168-195):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- source.deposit(n,address(this)) (src/vault/FixedRateVault.sol#180-181)
	Balance read before the call:
	- sharesBefore = source.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/vault/FixedRateVault.sol#177-179)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- source.balanceOf(address(this)) <= sharesBefore (src/vault/FixedRateVault.sol#181-182)
		- stale variable `sharesBefore`
